pages.text: NetheryX dungeons are built on several levels: guards, spawners and side rooms with chests, then the $(l)boss arena$(). The treasure lies in a small $(l)vault$() entirely made of $(item)Warded Masonry$() (unbreakable on all six faces) and closed by a door of $(item)Guardian Seals$(): it only opens when the boss dies.$(br2)Use the $(item)Soul Compass$() to find a dungeon. Bring armor, food and a $(item)Recall Stone$()!
pages.title: Donjons

pages.text: Unbreakable. Breaks by itself when the dungeon boss is defeated; the vault's masonry then turns back into ordinary bricks.
